<style id="ax-s120">
/* ============ Brief boundaries (s120, Jonathan 2026-10-08) ============
   Each brief carries its own position cue, scoped to the brief so it leaves the screen exactly when the brief ends:
   phone and tablet (<=1100px): a sticky bar (title, current section, progress line) that appears once the title has scrolled away;
   desktop (>1100px): a sticky section rail in the brief's left margin; every width: an end cap with the next brief.
   Tokens only, so flat and study modes follow. */
.brief{margin-bottom:56px}
.brief .bb-bar,.brief .bb-rail{display:none}

/* ---- phone and tablet: sticky bar ---- */
@media (max-width:1100px){
  .brief .bb-bar{display:flex;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:60;align-items:center;gap:6px;height:48px;margin:-22px -19px -48px;padding:0 8px 0 6px;
    background:var(--raised);box-shadow:var(--e2);border-radius:0 0 14px 14px;opacity:0;transform:translateY(-10px);pointer-events:none;
    transition:opacity .16s ease,transform .16s ease}
  .brief .bb-bar.on{opacity:1;transform:none;pointer-events:auto}
  .brief .bb-bar button{all:unset;box-sizing:border-box;cursor:pointer;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
  .brief .bb-bar button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px;border-radius:8px}
  .brief .bb-bar .bb-idx{flex:none;display:grid;place-items:center;width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:10px}
  .brief .bb-bar .bb-idx::before{content:"";width:15px;height:11px;background:linear-gradient(var(--ink-2) 0 2px,transparent 2px 4.5px,var(--ink-2) 4.5px 6.5px,transparent 6.5px 9px,var(--ink-2) 9px 11px)}
  .brief .bb-bar .bb-t{flex:1 1 auto;min-width:0;font:750 14px/1.2 var(--sans);color:var(--ink);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
  .brief .bb-bar .bb-sec{flex:0 1 auto;max-width:46%;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;height:34px;padding:0 10px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--principle-bg);
    font:700 12.5px/1 var(--sans);color:var(--principle);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden}
  .brief .bb-bar .bb-sec .bb-l{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
  .brief .bb-bar .bb-sec .bb-c{flex:none;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted)}
  .brief .bb-bar .bb-sec::after{content:"";flex:none;width:6px;height:6px;margin-left:2px;border-right:2px solid currentColor;border-bottom:2px solid currentColor;transform:translateY(-2px) rotate(45deg)}
  .brief .bb-prog{position:absolute;left:14px;right:14px;bottom:4px;height:3px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--hair);overflow:hidden}
  .brief .bb-prog i{display:block;height:100%;width:0;border-radius:2px;background:var(--accent)}
  .brief .bb-menu{position:absolute;right:8px;top:46px;min-width:200px;max-width:min(300px,86vw);max-height:60vh;overflow:auto;padding:6px;border-radius:14px;
    background:var(--raised);box-shadow:var(--e2),0 12px 28px -12px var(--dk)}
  .brief .bb-menu[hidden]{display:none}
  .brief .bb-menu button{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:baseline;width:100%;padding:10px 10px;border-radius:9px;font:650 14px/1.25 var(--sans);color:var(--ink)}
  .brief .bb-menu button b{min-width:16px;font-weight:800;color:var(--muted)}
  .brief .bb-menu button.cur{background:var(--principle-bg);color:var(--principle)}
  .brief .bb-menu button.cur b{color:var(--principle)}
  .brief .bb-menu button.off{color:var(--muted);cursor:default}
  body.bb-barred #navtab{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-14px);pointer-events:none}
  .brief h5[id],.brief [id].sp-dx,.brief [id].crit{scroll-margin-top:60px}
}
@media (max-width:640px){
  .brief .bb-bar{margin:-20px -15px -48px}
  /* overflow-x:hidden on body makes body its own scroll box, which pins nothing; clip trims the same overflow without that */
  html,body{overflow-x:clip}
}

/* ---- desktop: sticky section rail in the left margin ---- */
@media (min-width:1101px){
  .brief.bb-r{padding-left:178px}
  .brief .bb-rail{display:block;position:sticky;top:22px;z-index:5;width:122px;margin-left:-150px}
  .brief.bb-r .sp-step{display:none}
  .brief .bb-rt{margin:2px 0 10px 12px;font:800 10.5px/1.3 var(--sans);letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);
    display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden}
  .brief .bb-rl{position:relative;display:grid;gap:2px;padding-left:12px}
  .brief .bb-rl::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:4px;bottom:4px;width:3px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--hair)}
  .brief .bb-rl .bb-fill{position:absolute;left:0;top:4px;width:3px;height:0;max-height:calc(100% - 8px);border-radius:2px;background:var(--accent)}
  .brief .bb-rl a{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:7px;padding:7px 10px;border-radius:11px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--muted);font:650 13px/1.2 var(--sans)}
  .brief .bb-rl a b{flex:none;min-width:9px;font:800 12px/1 var(--sans)}
  .brief .bb-rl a:hover{color:var(--ink);background:var(--recess)}
  .brief .bb-rl a.cur{background:var(--ink);color:var(--raised);box-shadow:var(--e2)}
  .brief .bb-rl a.off{color:var(--muted);font-weight:500;pointer-events:none}
  .brief h5[id]{scroll-margin-top:22px}
}

/* ---- every width: end cap ---- */
.brief .bb-end{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px 16px;margin:26px 0 0;padding:16px 0 0;border-top:1px solid var(--hair);
  font:650 13px/1.35 var(--sans);color:var(--muted)}
.brief .bb-end .bb-el b{color:var(--ink-2)}
.brief .bb-end .bb-go{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
.brief .bb-end a,.brief .bb-end button{all:unset;box-sizing:border-box;cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;min-height:36px;padding:0 13px;border-radius:11px;
  background:var(--raised);box-shadow:var(--e2);font:700 13px/1.2 var(--sans);color:var(--principle)}
.brief .bb-end a[hidden]{display:none}
.brief .bb-end a:focus-visible,.brief .bb-end button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px}
@media print{.brief .bb-bar,.brief .bb-rail,.brief .bb-end{display:none!important}}
</style>
</head>
